sloka: चिरात्सुमाली व्यचरद्रसातलं स राक्षसो विष्णुभयार्दितस्तदा ।पुत्रैश्च पौत्रैश्च समन्वितो बली ततस्तु लङ्कामवसद्धनेश्वरः ।। ७.८.२९ ।।
transliteration: cirātsumālī vyacaradrasātalaṁ sa rākṣaso viṣṇubhayārditastadā ।putraiśca pautraiśca samanvito balī tatastu laṅkāmavasaddhaneśvaraḥ ।। 7.8.29 ।।

translations.english: O King of men, I have today narrated to you the complete and proper origin of the Rākṣasas; now, O best of Raghu's lineage, listen further to the entire incomparable power and birth of Rāvaṇa along with his sons.
